Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated thermal effects and Daylight Saving Time with shadow length. Shadow length depends on solar elevation and is shortest at solar noon (when the sun is highest), not when the day is warmest. Even with DST shifting clock time, 12:05 pm is far closer to solar noon than 4:05 pm. This led to the incorrect selection of C instead of the correct B (12:05 in the afternoon).
